youtube_description:
WATCH: Our correspondent, @publicedtay, explains why you should pay attention to the race for NC Commissioner of Agriculture. 🧑‍🌾

Sarah Taber, the woman hoping to unseat longtime state Commissioner of Agriculture Steve Troxler, is focusing her campaign on rural labor, infrastructure, and business. She wants to shift production to more sustainable crops and make growing a more profitable job.

For more NC news and politics, follow @cardinalandpine.
